description: This file contains unit tests for the AnySoftKeyboard application, specifically testing the behavior of physical keyboard input handling, status icon visibility, and keyboard layout switching based on key events and user preferences.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardPhysicalKeyboardTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying physical keyboard input handling, status icon visibility, and layout switching in the AnySoftKeyboard app.

classes.name: TestKeyEvent
classes.description: A subclass of KeyEvent used for simulating key events in tests, including parcelable implementation.

methods.name: createEditorInfoTextWithSuggestionsForSetUp
methods.description: Creates an EditorInfo object with specific fieldId and packageName, and sets the keyboard configuration to no keys.

methods.name: setUpAndHideInput
methods.description: Prepares the test environment and ensures input is hidden.

methods.name: testDoesNotShowStatusBarIcon
methods.description: Verifies that the status bar icon is not shown when the preference is disabled.

methods.name: testHidesStatusBarIconOnPrefsChange
methods.description: Checks that changing the preference to hide the icon results in the icon being hidden.

methods.name: testShowsStatusBarIconOnPrefsChange
methods.description: Verifies that enabling the icon preference shows the status icon and that relevant details are set.

methods.name: testStatusBarIconLifeCycle
methods.description: Tests the lifecycle of the status icon through input start, view show/hide, and input finish events.

methods.name: testNoStatusBarIconIfDisabled
methods.description: Ensures that the status icon remains hidden if the preference is disabled.

methods.name: testKeyboardViewHiddenWhenPhysicalKeyPressed
methods.description: Checks that the keyboard view is hidden when a physical key is pressed.

methods.name: testKeyboardViewNotHiddenWhenVirtualKeyPressed
methods.description: Ensures the keyboard view remains visible when a virtual key is pressed.

methods.name: testKeyboardViewNotHiddenWhenPhysicalNonPrintableKeyPressed
methods.description: Verifies that non-printable physical keys do not hide the keyboard view.

methods.name: testKeyboardReOpenOnNewInputConnectionField
methods.description: Tests that the keyboard reopens when a new input connection with a different fieldId is started.

methods.name: testKeyboardReOpenIfInputConnectionFieldIsZero
methods.description: Checks that the keyboard reopens if the input connection's fieldId is zero.

methods.name: testKeyboardReOpenOnPreviousInputConnectionFieldIfPhysicalKeyboardWasNotPressed
methods.description: Verifies re-opening behavior when returning to a previous input connection without physical key presses.

methods.name: testKeyboardStaysHiddenOnPreviousInputConnectionField
methods.description: Ensures the keyboard remains hidden when returning to the same input connection.

methods.name: testKeyboardReOpenOnPreviousInputConnectionFieldAfterProperClose
methods.description: Tests re-opening after proper input closure and reopening.

methods.name: testKeyboardReOpenOnInputConfigurationChange
methods.description: Verifies that the keyboard reopens correctly after input configuration changes.

methods.name: testKeyboardStaysHiddenOnPreviousInputConnectionFieldAfterJustViewFinish
methods.description: Ensures the keyboard remains hidden after just finishing the input view.

methods.name: testKeyboardSwitchesLayoutOnAltSpace
methods.description: Tests layout switching when Alt+Space is pressed.

methods.name: testKeyboardNoLayoutSwitchOnAltSpace
methods.description: Verifies no layout switch occurs when the preference disables Alt+Space shortcut.

methods.name: testKeyboardSwitchesLayoutOnShiftSpace
methods.description: Tests layout switching when Shift+Space is pressed.

methods.name: testKeyboardNoLayoutSwitchOnShiftSpace
methods.description: Verifies no layout switch occurs when the preference disables Shift+Space shortcut.
